d: Bihar ke mujaphpharpur jile ke sadar thana kshetr antargat patahi ganv men ek vivahita ki sandigdh paristhitiyon men maut ke bad jabardast haee-voltej drama dekhne ko mila. is ghatna se aakroshit mayke valon ne postamartam ke bad mritka ka shav sidhe uske sasural le jakar ghar ke mukhy dvar ke thik samne hi chita sajakar antim sanskar kar diya. ghatna ke bad se sasural paksh ke sabhi log ghar chhorkar pharar ho gae hain. mritka ki pahchan 37 varshiy vibha thakur (pati chandan thakur) ke rup men huee hai.
